purpose: Narrow RESOLVED-INPUTS successor that reconciles DELIVERY's tool-paths-enter-PlanId promise and binds the Rust handshake capability record to the signed capability manifest. It does not edit or silently widen resolved-inputs.v2.json.

dependencyPins.use: closed rust-v1 universe and PLAN-ID-V1 field mapping
signed capability manifest and repository-execution promise
closed capability-grant value included in PlanDescriptor field 10

protocolReference.applicationRule: This join, the protocol contract and the DELIVERY join must be independently reviewed and formally applied as one dependency-locked candidate set.

order: admit the exact per-project repository-execution grant in frozen PlanIntent
if granted, run the bounded network-disabled repository-resolution preparation outside the semantic sidecar
seal build-script/procedural-macro outputs and exact logical tool-path records
construct the complete closed rust-v1 resolvedInputs and exact capabilityGrant parameters
start the Rust semantic sidecar immediately before its admitted stage
repositoryExecutionPlanBinding.why: rust-v1 buildScriptOutputs and procMacroOutputs are PlanId inputs, while the semantic child starts only after PlanId. Letting that child create those outputs would make PlanId depend on a future result and is forbidden.

defaultDisabled.semanticOutcomeWhenGeneratedCfgIsRequire: Coverage unknown with deficiency provider-unavailable; never silently fall back to an incomplete universe

granted.grantProjectRule: grant.projectId exactly equals PlanIntent scope.projectId and Snapshot descriptor.projectId
granted.outputRule: Every buildScriptOutputs and procMacroOutputs row in rust-v1 equals the sealed result of this preparation; no later sidecar output may add, replace or default a row.

fields.tool-paths: array of ToolPathV1, strict ascending tuple (role UTF-8 bytes, bundleRelativePath UTF-8 bytes), no duplicates; empty exactly when both execution booleans are false and non-empty otherwise

repositoryExecutionGrantParametersV1.c2Carrier: The exact map is capabilityGrants[].parameters under C-2 BoundedParameterValue. PLAN-ID-V1 field 10 encodes the complete capabilityGrants array with CVE1, so every ToolPathV1 value enters PlanId without widening the closed rust-v1 record.
repositoryExecutionGrantParametersV1.unknownParameterRule: Reject before repository execution and PlanId construction.

fields.bundleRelativePath: non-empty NFC forward-slash relative path beneath the verified toolchain bundle; no leading slash, backslash, empty, dot or dot-dot segment, drive prefix or NUL
fields.fileSha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 characters of the selected file bytes

toolPathV1.selectionRule: List every executable or dynamic loader selected by repository-resolution preparation. A used path absent from the array, a listed path not beneath the verified bundle root, or a digest mismatch rejects before execution.
toolPathV1.physicalMapping: At execution, the host resolves bundleRelativePath beneath the verified absolute rust-toolchain-bundle root and rechecks containment and fileSha256. The machine-specific absolute root is operational and does not enter PlanId; the exact logical path and bytes digest do.

fields.relations: non-empty closed string map exactly equal to the selected signed ProfileEntry CapabilityManifestV1 ProviderCapability.relations row for rust-semantic
fields.platformIds: exact array from that signed row; current DELIVERY value is [all-supported]

capabilityHandshakeBinding.planCommitment: The selected signed capability manifest is identified by rust-v1.capabilityManifestId, which is a required PLAN-ID-V1 field. The handshake record is not a new free-standing capability source; it must be exact recursive equality with the rust-semantic row committed by that identifier.
hostValidationOrder: verify release and selected profile signatures/digests
select the one rust-semantic ProviderCapability row
verify rust-v1.capabilityManifestId names that exact capability manifest
send the expected closed row in Hello
receive the closed row in HelloAck
require exact recursive equality between expected row, returned row and signed row before OpenUniverse or any SnapshotFileChunk
capabilityHandshakeBinding.mismatch: Terminate/reap the child, disclose no source bytes, discard all candidates, and project provider-protocol / PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION through the conditional DELIVERY join. A producer boolean, claimed support string or field presence never establishes equality.

providerRequestProjection.disabled: OpenUniverse.repositoryResolution is the exact closed disabled variant: mode=disabled, grantId=null, projectId=scope.projectId, buildScriptOutputs=[], procMacroOutputs=[], toolPaths=[] and network=false.
providerRequestProjection.prepared: OpenUniverse.repositoryResolution is the exact closed prepared variant: mode=prepared, grantId is the admitted repository-execution grantId, projectId is exact, buildScriptOutputs and procMacroOutputs equal rust-v1 resolvedInputs, toolPaths equal the exact PlanId-bound grant parameter array and network=false.
providerRequestProjection.authorityRule: The semantic provider may validate and consume this projection. It may not execute project code, replace output digests, resolve a different path, fetch a tool or broaden a grant.

changeRules: Changing a tool role, logical path, file digest, execution boolean, grant identity or project identity changes capabilityGrants CVE1 and therefore PlanId.
Changing the selected signed capability manifest or rust-semantic row changes capabilityManifestId and therefore PlanId.
A handshake capability mismatch cannot produce provider execution or a substitute PlanId.
No system path, absolute installation prefix, temporary extraction root or PATH order is a semantic PlanId input.
residuals: Formal integration into RESOLVED-INPUTS and DELIVERY is outside this candidate.
The host repository-resolution adapter and any process-level enforcement are architecture-owned but remain unimplemented and unqualified.
Independent review must verify that the C-2 capability-grant carrier and PLAN-ID-V1 tag 10 make the tool-path record load-bearing without widening rust-v1.
